name: DeadEye
storyline:
DeadEye is a frantic, pixel-art 2D roguelike shooter set in a world consumed by pacts and secrets. You play as either Douglas or Blood Samurai, heroes bound to the mysterious DeadEye pact, an ability that stops time and allows you to chain lethal actions in an instant. You must use every second to survive hordes of monsters, complete quests, defeat ruthless bosses—including Lorian, a powerful lich guarding the cursed graveyard—and unravel the truth behind DeadEye.

Douglas's Journey: After forging a pact with an enigmatic being, Douglas gained the power to manipulate time and chain deadly actions together. However, despite his immense power, something stirs within him. His soul has felt heavy and empty for a long time, and his instincts tell him that the answer lies within DeadEye. Driven by the need to reclaim what he has lost and to discover the true price of his gift, Douglas travels through a hostile world in search of the truth.
summary: Stop time and master your revolver in this intense 2D roguelike shooter. Face relentless hordes, defeat brutal bosses, forge powerful pacts, and collect artifacts and pets as you fight for survival.
